{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Replace -1 in customer_age with NaN (sentinel for missing data)
sales['customer_age'] = sales['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)

# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = sales[sales['converted'] == 1]

# Compute mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Round to two decimal places
mean_age_converted_rounded = round(mean_age_converted, 2)

# Print only the final rounded value
print(mean_age_converted_rounded)"}
